name: Adaptive Voxelization of Unstructured Grids
aliases: Hierarchical 3D Texture Mapping for Unstructured Grids
definition: A system for interactively rendering large, unstructured grids by converting them into a hierarchical 3D texture (voxel octree) and rendering via 3D texture mapping. It solves the problem of rendering large, out-of-core unstructured datasets on standard PC hardware by leveraging 3D texture mapping acceleration.
